claims: Duke University is a private research university.
Duke University is located in Durham, North Carolina.
Duke University is situated within North Carolina's Research Triangle region.
Duke University's campus spans nearly 9,000 acres.
Duke University's campus has Gothic architecture.
Duke University's campus includes the Duke Chapel.
The Triangle region is near Raleigh and Chapel Hill.
Duke University has a historic West Campus.
Duke University has an East Campus.
Duke University's West Campus and East Campus are connected by 9th Street and Campus Drive.
Duke University has a campus in Kunshan, China.
Duke Kunshan University is Duke University's campus in Kunshan, China.
Duke University has a medical school in Singapore.
Duke-NUS Graduate Medical School is Duke University's medical school in Singapore.
